free_tier_limits.correction: Free-tier keys permit 60 read requests/minute and 5 write requests/minute and expire after 30 days.

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published. OpenSea uses a token-bucket system, returns X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers, and returns Retry-After with HTTP 429 responses. Instant free-tier keys allow 60 read requests/minute and 5 write requests/minute.

notes: The API is operational and the documented V2 collections request remains valid. The entry fails because current official documentation now states concrete free-tier limits and publishes rate-limit behavior, contradicting both 'unknown' and 'not published'.
